visualCharacteristics.purpose: Section introduction with a large heading on the left and supporting copy on the right
visualCharacteristics.layout: two equal columns on desktop, stacked on mobile; no images

contentPattern.structure: One row with two cells: H2 heading | paragraph(s) with optional link

reuseGuidance: Use to introduce a section (e.g. steps or features) where heading and lead copy sit side by side.
